minecraft_bubble.description: All front and threequarter frames show only flat grass and sky. Top views show the persistent brown dirt-debris pile (background) and nothing else. No particle-like pixels at any tick.
minecraft_bubble.notes: Likely an underwater-only particle that does not render in air; nothing but the background debris pile is present.

minecraft_current_down.description: Every frame equals the empty baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, and the brown debris pile in top views. No particles at any angle or tick.
minecraft_current_down.notes: Consistent with a water-only current particle; invisible on land.

minecraft_dust.description: t3: a dense irregular cloud of small cyan/teal-blue pixelated square specks hovering at the horizon line (front and threequarter). t8: cloud has split into a few looser speck clusters drifting apart. t20: nearly gone, only 2-3 tiny specks. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_dust.notes: Cluster sits at ground level near the anchor; clearly readable in both horizontal angles.

minecraft_end_rod.description: A single soft white puffball blob near the horizon in front and threequarter views at t3 and t8, roughly stable in position. At t20 only a few faint off-white remnant specks remain. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_end_rod.notes: t20 remnants are very faint; main puff clearly visible at t3/t8.

minecraft_falling_obsidian_tear.description: Front/threequarter: tiny violet specks at sky height at t3, small purple streaks resting on the grass by t8, a couple of faint purple dashes further along the ground at t20. Top view is dramatic: two enormous solid violet flat quads lying on the ground at t3 (several blocks wide), thinning to short purple dashes at t8 and t20.
minecraft_falling_obsidian_tear.notes: Particles are camera-facing quads, so the top view exaggerates them into giant violet slabs; front views read as small falling specks.

minecraft_gust_emitter_large.description: t3 only: a massive white/gray wind vortex fills the upper frame in front and threequarter views - opaque white cloud masses, several gray spiral curl hooks, and long dashed diagonal streaks. Also visible as white spiral arcs in top view at t3. Completely gone by t8 and t20.

scale_impression: very large, fills half the frame

minecraft_gust_emitter_large.notes: Strongest effect in the batch; unmistakable large-scale vortex.

minecraft_landing_honey.description: A small amber/golden smear resting on the grass near the anchor, visible at the same spot in front and threequarter views at all three ticks with slight shape change (splatter wobble). In top views, short amber-orange streaks appear beside the brown debris at t8 and t20.
minecraft_landing_honey.notes: Effect is subtle and close to the ground; amber tint is distinct from the darker debris pile.

minecraft_portal.description: Small curved clusters of tiny magenta/violet pixel specks high in the sky: visible in front view at t3 (upper left) and t8 (upper center), and a couple of specks in threequarter t3/t8. Nothing at t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_portal.notes: Only a handful of pixels; clearly colored but small enough to overlook at sheet scale.

minecraft_small_gust.description: A single small pale-gray/white curled wisp (a tiny hook-shaped puff) in the upper sky at t3 in front and threequarter views. Nothing at t8 or t20; top views show only background debris.
minecraft_small_gust.notes: Very low contrast; verified by zooming the cell - the curl is real but easy to miss.

minecraft_squid_ink.description: t3: a dense splat of chunky black square particles clumped into one blob near the horizon (largest in threequarter view, ~60px; a few dark specks in front view). t8: two small dark specks low near the ground. t20: nothing. Top views show only debris.
minecraft_squid_ink.notes: The 3q t3 splat is the strongest single frame; effect reads as a thrown ink blob.

minecraft_wax_off.description: A handful of pale cream-pink four-pointed star/plus-shaped sparkle specks near the horizon at t3 (front and threequarter), one or two tiny specks at t8, none at t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_wax_off.notes: Star/plus shape confirmed by zoom; sparse and low contrast.

world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_DEACTIVATE.description: t3: a loose burst of ~15 small flame-sprite specks - yellow-orange bodies with red-orange tips - scattered across the upper sky (front view strongest; fewer in threequarter). t8: 2-3 small orange stragglers. t20: nothing. Top views show only debris.
world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_DEACTIVATE.notes: Brief one-shot burst; front t3 is the only frame where it is dense.

world_event_PARTICLES_ELECTRIC_SPARK.description: All frames are empty baseline: flat grass and sky in front/threequarter, brown debris pile in top views. No spark-like pixels at any tick or angle.
world_event_PARTICLES_ELECTRIC_SPARK.notes: Either the effect failed to render or its particles are sub-pixel; nothing distinguishable from baseline.

world_event_PARTICLES_SPELL_POTION_SPLAS.description: t3: dozens of small orange-red hollow spiral/ring particles (open circular outlines) scattered widely across the upper sky and a few near the ground, in front and threequarter views. t8: mostly gone, a few faint rings. t20: a single ring plus a small red square in threequarter. Top views show only debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_SPELL_POTION_SPLAS.notes: Distinctive spiral-ring silhouette; the widest-spread burst in the batch.

superheroes_anomaly_slice.description: A compact loose cloud of a few dozen tiny white/pale specks floating at sky height. Across ticks the whole cloud translates left-to-right within the frame (left at t3, center at t8, right at t20) in both front and threequarter rows, slightly dimmer and thinner by t20. Top views show only debris.
superheroes_anomaly_slice.notes: The cluster visibly moves sideways between ticks, suggesting a traveling emitter or drifting group.

superheroes_goku_kamehameha_trail.description: A tight irregular blob of dark navy-blue pixelated quads with lighter blue/white highlights sits at sky height and translates left-to-right across the frame over the three ticks (front and threequarter). Slightly paler and looser at t20. Top t20 also shows a large blue region at the right frame edge, but it is textured like water/terrain and treated as world geometry.
superheroes_goku_kamehameha_trail.notes: The large blue area in top t20 reads as water/terrain edge, not the effect; the moving blue blob is the real effect.

superheroes_homelander_roar_wave.description: All frames equal the empty baseline: flat grass, sky horizon, background debris in top views. No visible effect at any tick or angle.
superheroes_homelander_roar_wave.notes: Likely a non-particle effect (sound/shake) or it failed to render; nothing in the pixels.

superheroes_naruto_kawarimi_smoke.description: A small cluster of large white/cream hollow-ring smoke puffs (soft circular outlines with empty centers) at sky level, translating left-to-right across ticks and thinning by t20, visible in front and threequarter views. Top t20 additionally shows large pale flat rectangular patches on the ground - ambiguous, could be settled smoke or terrain.
superheroes_naruto_kawarimi_smoke.notes: Pale ground rectangles in top t20 may be smoke settling or a terrain feature; flagged ambiguous.

superheroes_silent.description: Every frame is the empty baseline: flat grass and sky, debris pile in top views. Nothing visible at any tick or angle.
superheroes_silent.notes: Consistent with an intentionally silent/invisible event; no pixels to interpret.

vfxlab_ribbon_trail.description: All front and threequarter frames are empty baseline. Top views show only the brown debris pile (large clump at t3, scattered chunks at t8). No ribbon or trail pixels anywhere.
vfxlab_ribbon_trail.notes: No ribbon geometry rendered in any frame; possibly a failed spawn or off-camera trail.
